bugs.description: Over max_turns: scenario completed in 9 turns vs expected max_turns=8. New customer flow (policy gate + name collection) requires 2 extra turns beyond what max_turns=8 anticipates. The booking succeeded, but the turn budget in scenarios-v2.yaml is systematically too low for new-customer booking scenarios.

gcal_sync_status=synced instead of not_applicable. TEST_MODE_GCAL_SKIP=true was set in the api container exec env but not in the agent container process env. The agent container needs its own env var set to skip GCal push. Actual GCal sync likely failed silently (no real GCal credentials for sandbox phone), or succeeded if service account is configured. Not a correctness bug — booking itself is correct.

notes.tool_inference_basis: agent responses + availability_service logs — turn 3 response confirms check_availability fired (today blocked by minimum-notice rule), turn 4 response shows 3 next-available options (get_next_available_options), turn 9 confirms booking created (book). tool_evidence=[]=[] from harness because CheckpointToolEvidenceAdapter found no checkpoint (cleared by state_reset before evidence collection), qa_tool_trace stream not populated, conversation_turns not written (Chatwoot 404 on sandbox UUID).
notes.chatwoot_sandbox_note: All Chatwoot API calls returned 404 — expected for sandbox conversation_id not registered in Chatwoot. Agent pipeline processed turns correctly regardless.
notes.infra_note: All harness commands run via docker exec in api container (PYTHONPATH=/app). venv on server host is empty — packages only available inside containers.
